We have search results with several templates. Need to return the mapped_rxn associated with the template that, when applied to the molecule (target) reproduces the reaction described: nucleophilic aromatic substitution (SNAr) where nucleophile (amine) replaces a leaving group (halide) on aromatic ring, with electron-withdrawing groups (nitro etc). However the target molecule given earlier? The input from previous step: answer: '[["c1ccc(N)cc1","ClS(=O)(=O)c1ccc(F)cc1"]]' That seems to be precursors: an aniline (c1ccc(N)cc1) and a sulfonyl chloride with fluorophenyl (ClS(=O)(=O)c1ccc(F)cc1). The product would be c1ccc(N(S(=O)(=O)c1ccc(F)cc1))cc1 (an aryl sulfonamide). So the reaction is formation of sulfonamide via nucleophilic substitution of sulfonyl chloride (leaving group Cl) by amine. So we need template that breaks halide (Cl) and forms sulfonamide (sulfonamides). The search gave templates; we need to pick the appropriate one that matches our target. Look at first result: reaction_id 883063, retro_smarts_template: '[C:7]-[NH;D2;+0:8]-[S;H0;D4;+0:1](=[O;D1;H0:2])(=[O;D1;H0:3])/[C:4]=[C:5]/[C:6]>>Cl-[S;H0;D4;+0:1](=[O;D1;H0:2])(=[O;D1;H0:3])/[C:4]=[C:5]/[C:6].[C:7]-[NH2;D1;+0:8]'

This is exactly sulfonamide formation: product is C- NH - S(=O)2 - aryl; reactants: sulfonyl chloride (Cl-S(=O)2-aryl) + amine (C-NH2). The mapped_rxn is given. So we should return mapped_rxn and template_id (the one used to search the database not the hash). The template_id is likely the reaction_id? Or template_id field? In result dict, there is 'reaction_id' and 'template_hash'. The required output says template_id (the one used to search the database not the hash). Probably reaction_id is the template_id. So we return {'mapped_rxn': ..., 'template_id': 883063}. Use the mapped_rxn from that entry.

Let's extract mapped_rxn string: It's long. Provided in result: 'mapped_rxn': '[CH3:1][C:2]1=[N:3][C:4]2=[CH:5][CH:6]=[CH:7][CH:8]=[C:9]2[C:10]([NH:11][CH2:12][CH2:13][NH2:14])=[CH:23]1.CCN(CC)CC.[CH3:21][CH:20]([CH3:22])/[CH:19]=[CH:18]/[S:15](=[O:16])(=[O:17])Cl.CC#N.ClCCl>>[CH3:1][C:2]1=[N:3][C:4]2=[CH:5][CH:6]=[CH:7][CH:8]=[C:9]2[C:10]([NH:11][CH2:12][CH2:13][NH:14][S:15](=[O:16])(=[O:17])/[CH:18]=[CH:19]/[CH:20]([CH3:21])[CH3:22])=[CH:23]1'

That's the mapped reaction. So final answer.
